label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall: 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns, with the mayor brought in under the stated purpose of a lighting inspection. Builder, freight and innkeeper organized, funded and transported supplies; baker knowingly supplied and baked bread, kept the secret and extended grain credit. No additional knowing helper is established: secretary scheduled an approved lighting inspection but is not shown knowing the jubilee purpose; neighbour overheard privacy requests but is not shown helping. The mayor was told about the lighting inspection, not the celebration.
